changes.to: Scope review (#16, 2026-11-17): kept as an in-scope Quadruped. Being rideable is not grounds for Misc - the catalog already files Kawasaki CORLEO (also rideable) as Quadruped and RHP Bex as Wheel-legged. The X1 walks on four point feet and carries a rider: a mobile robot, not a car or a toy. Values from DaxAI's WRC 2026 launch release (Aug 19, 2026): 165 V pack, 40 km range, 8-10 h, 1,400 Nm joint torque. The maker's own site (daxrobotics.cn) lists the Qiji line only as 骑骥 T1000, so there is no X1 product page yet and the sources stay press-based.
